rationale: Repoints the mac-x86_64 Skia release-asset selector at the already-pinned universal skia-build archive (the asset mac-arm64 and mac-universal already use, and the one gpu-runtime's renderer lock pins), updates the matching VERSION.md digest rows and min_os.json source notes, and makes audit.py --strict require every mac-* asset to carry the lock's digest. With every macOS selector on that archive, PulpGpuRuntime.cmake drops its architecture opt-out, so x86_64 and universal builds forward the device layer to gpu-runtime exactly as arm64 builds already do (gpu-runtime-apple-targets replaces gpu-runtime-covers-target). No new asset, milestone, Dawn build or renderer is introduced; the x86_64 objects linked are byte-identical to the thin archive's. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
